# Decision log

## 14. Decision log

| **\#** | **Decision** | **Rejected alternative** | **Consequence** |
|----|----|----|----|
| D1 | Feature parity with a new API | Drop-in compatibility; adapter shim | Clean core; a migration you own |
| D2 | wasm-bindgen in one crate only | Bindings wherever convenient | Phases 2 and 3 are entry points, not rewrites |
| D3 | Pixels never cross the boundary | Decode in wasm, render in JS | The main architectural gain |
| D4 | Events polled from a ring, per frame | A JS callback per event | Removes the hot-path crossing; free coalescing |
| D5 | Single-threaded, one instance per worker | wasm-bindgen-rayon from the start | Stays on stable Rust |
| D6 | WebGPU primary, WebGL2 a declared tier | WebGL2 only; WebGPU only | Two shader paths; compute degrades, never fails |
| D7 | Validation oracle before port code | Validation as a tail phase | Makes generated Rust safe to merge at volume |
| D8 | Adopt Orthanc or dcm4che for Phase 2 | Build DIMSE on dicom-ul | Saves ~20 engineer-months, to be better not worse |
| D9 | Integrate itk-wasm / elastix | Write registration in Rust | Avoids 20–35 engineer-months of unvalidated code |
| D10 | Keep dcmjs for SR generation | Reimplement TID 1500 in Rust | Standards conformance for near-zero cost |
| D11 | Chunked residency is the default path | Brick only above a size threshold | Bounded GPU memory becomes a claim, not a fallback |
| D12 | Compute is a separate crate sharing one device | Kernels inside ocelli-render | Compute is usable headless and server-side unchanged |
| D13 | The annotation type is a DICOM SR content tree | An internal model with SR adapters | Every measurement is interoperable by construction |
| D14 | Attestation claims measured divergence | Claim bit-exact reproducibility | Honest, publishable, and actually achievable |
